articles.title: Retail Revival Adds Fuel to US Stocks, JPMorgan Strategists Say
articles.summary: Retail investors’ share of US equity trading is poised to rebound after falling to a four-year low by the end of the first quarter, according to JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists, potentially providing a fresh tailwind for stocks.

articles.title: Drone Makers Quantum and Destinus Seek Banks for 2027 IPOs
articles.summary: Quantum Systems and Destinus are in talks to line up advisers for potential IPOs as soon as early 2027, people familiar with the matter said, as the drone makers seek to tap surging demand for unmanned defense assets.

articles.title: Protestas en Bolivia desploman sus bonos soberanos y amenazan con caos
articles.summary: Bolivia vuelve a encender las alarmas. Las protestas y bloqueos ya afectan el abastecimiento en La Paz y desploman su imagen internacional, mientras crece la presión sobre el presidente Rodrigo Paz apenas meses después de asumir el poder.  (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: China AI Upstart MiniMax Doubles Sales Ahead of New Model
articles.summary: MiniMax Group Inc.’s annualized revenue more than doubled over the past two months to at least $300 million, as the Chinese AI upstart prepares to roll out its next flagship model to entice developers and enterprise clients.

articles.title: Markets ‘Too Complacent’ Around Impact of Inflation, PGIM’s Peters Says
articles.summary: Gregory Peters, co-chief investment officer at PGIM Credit, says he sees "shock, after shock, after shock" in markets. "That leads to higher inflation," Peters says, adding this has an impact on central banks' interest-rate positioning. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: China Minister Again Skips Defense Forum Attended by Hegseth
articles.summary: China’s top military diplomat will skip Asia’s biggest defense forum for a second year in a row, ceding to the US and its allies an opportunity for public defense diplomacy.

articles.title: Micron’s Cheap Stock Valuation Seen as a Contrarian Warning Sign
articles.summary: Micron Technology Inc. is the third-best performer in the S&P 500 Index this year and at the same time one of the least expensive stocks in the market. While that dichotomy looks bullish on the surface, it may be more of a warning sign than a green light for investors.

articles.title: Crisis en España: Zapatero complica la reelección de Sánchez
articles.summary: La investigación judicial contra José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero amenaza con convertirse en un problema político de gran escala para Pedro Sánchez, justo cuando el gobierno enfrenta crecientes tensiones y pérdida de apoyos. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Deutsche Bank Chairman Pay Hike Rejected as Too Much by Investor
articles.summary: Deutsche Bank AG’s plan to give a big pay raise to Supervisory Board Chairman Alexander Wynaendts drew criticism at the lender’s annual general meeting.

articles.title: TikTok Is Driving A Men’s Fragrance Boom
articles.summary: What's that smell? It could be a TikTok influencer who’s doused himself in the scent he’s pitching. Corporations and influencers alike are capitalizing on a post-pandemic boom in fragrances in the US, particularly among men. Rainier Harris reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Guangzhou Exchange Said to Study Night Trading for Platinum
articles.summary: China’s Guangzhou Futures Exchange is exploring launching night trading, primarily for platinum and palladium contracts, in response to trader feedback, according to people familiar with the matter.
